from pathlib import Path
p=Path('internal/storage/fs/snapshot.go'); s=p.read_text(); s=s.replace('SegmentKey:   r.SegmentKey,\\n\\t\\t\\t\\tSegmentKeys:  r.SegmentKeys,\\n',''); a=s.index('\\t\\t\\tif rule.SegmentKey "'!= "" {'"'); b=s.index('\\n\\t\\t\\tfor _, segmentKey :=',a); s=s[:a]+'''            operator := flipt.SegmentOperator_OR_SEGMENT_OPERATOR
            switch segment := r.Segment.IsSegment.(type) {
            case ext.SegmentKey:
                rule.SegmentKey = string(segment)
                segmentKeys = append(segmentKeys, string(segment))
            case ext.Segments:
                segmentKeys = append(segmentKeys, segment.Keys...)
                if len(segment.Keys) == 1 { rule.SegmentKey = segment.Keys[0] } else {
                    rule.SegmentKeys = segment.Keys
                    operator = flipt.SegmentOperator(flipt.SegmentOperator_value[segment.SegmentOperator])
                }
            default:
                return fmt.Errorf(\"rule %d has invalid segment\", rank)
            }

PY
